Copy to ~/.config/enfocus-switch-mcp/customer_rules.json, edit, and set CUSTOMER_RULES. accept = issue categories the customer has accepted (no longer make the verdict 'needs customer'); prepress_fixes = categories we fix in-house for them; ticket_defaults = defaults for the file-vs-ticket check (bleed_in, binding). Categories are the keys in src/switch_mcp/knowledge.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The entries below are EXAMPLES: replace them.
